title: Match Normalized Text While Guarding Exact Text
task: Using docxedit only, work with a paragraph whose visible text contains a repeated whitespace run.
Address it through a text selector written with single spaces and confirm check resolves the intended target.
Show that an expect-text guard written with single spaces fails while the exact-spaced guard passes.
Apply the exact-guarded patch to a separate output .docx and verify with docxedit read and docxedit validate that only the find span changed.
successCriteria: Shows the normalized selector resolving and the normalized guard failing with E3201.
Produces an output .docx where only the find span changed and spacing is preserved.
Does not inspect raw OOXML package parts or quote private document text.
observerQuestions: Did the agent distinguish normalized matching from exact guarding without confusion?
Was the E3201 guard failure legible as a spacing mismatch rather than a wrong target?
